pages.text: Product and facility certification | Veridens Skip to content Solutions Products Contact Svenska Book a demo Solutions Audit and inspection, from planning to certificate For bodies that certify products, facilities and operations through on-site audit or inspection. Book a demo Sound familiar? Our inspectors plan their routes by hand. Planning suggests routes from the facilities that are due, the region and how many visits fit in a day. Facilities get a visit notice by email. Customers email their corrective actions and we lose track. The customer answers non-conformities with action plans in the portal. The auditor accepts or rejects them with a comment. Self-assessments never get collected. The customer completes the self-assessment in the portal and gets a reminder when it is due. Every certificate template is a Word document. Templates are built in a visual designer. Certificates are produced as PDF and can be verified through a public link. One flow for audit and inspection From the first application to recurring visits. Application Business, facilities and questionnaires. Planning Route suggestions, visits per day and calendar invites. Certificate Issued from a template, as PDF with public verification. Follow-up Self-assessment between visits and the next audit on time. What is included The parts work on their own or together. pages.title: Organic and food certification | Veridens
pages.text: Organic and food certification | Veridens Skip to content Solutions Products Contact Svenska Book a demo Solutions Organic and food, with TRACES NT and KRAV connected For control and certification bodies working with KRAV, EU organic, IP Sigill and Från Sverige. Audit, risk assessment and certificates in one flow. Book a demo Sound familiar? Certificates have to go into TRACES NT, so we type everything twice. The certificate is issued in TRACES NT straight from the system and the PDF comes back to the case. Reports to KRAV and the Board of Agriculture take days to put together. Crop, livestock, greenhouse and beekeeping reports go to KRAV through their API. Statistics for the Swedish Board of Agriculture come from the same data. Non-conformities sit open with nobody following up. The customer answers with an action plan in the portal. The auditor accepts it or rejects it with a comment, and the system sends reminders about open non-conformities. Risk assessment lives in a separate spreadsheet. Risk is assessed per facility and with the KRAV and EU organic risk model, inside the audit. From application to the next audit The same flow for farming, processing, retail and restaurants. Application The customer registers the business and facilities and answers questions. Planning The audit is scheduled and calendar invites go to customer and auditor. Audit Checklists, risk assessment and non-conformities are recorded. Actions The customer submits action plans. Reminders continue until the non-conformity is closed. Certificate Issued, published in a searchable register and in TRACES NT where needed. Next audit Created from the certificate's validity period. Schemes, operations and connections Crop codes, articles and ingredients are kept as their own registers. Schemes KRAV EU organic IP Sigill IP Klimat IP Arbetsvillkor Från Sverige Operations Farming Greenhouse Beekeeping Aquaculture Wild collection Processing Retail and restaurants Connections TRACES NT KRAV Swedish Board of Agriculture Fortnox Unit4 Agresso See your audit in the system We show the flow with your schemes and your checklists. pages.title: Personnel certification to ISO/IEC 17024 | Veridens
pages.text: Personnel certification to ISO/IEC 17024 | Veridens Skip to content Solutions Products Contact Svenska Book a demo Solutions Personnel certification from application to renewal For bodies certifying people to ISO/IEC 17024. Applicants apply online; you assess and decide in the same case. Book a demo Personnel certification under your brand, in two minutes Application, review, certificate and invoicing under your own brand. Sample data, music only. Sound familiar? Applications arrive by email, incomplete and without evidence. Applicants fill in the application step by step, with the requirements for that specific certification. Experience and education are recorded in a structured way and the application is signed with BankID. Every year we chase competence reports in Excel. Certificate holders submit reports and proof of work in the portal, per reporting period. You see at once who has reported and who is missing. We find out a certificate has expired when someone asks. The holder gets a reminder before the certificate expires, and the renewal becomes its own case in the same flow. It is hard to show the assessor how a decision was reached. Review against control points, non-conformities and the decision are kept together in the case. The decision is a separate step for the person authorised to decide. How a case runs The same flow for initial certification, renewal and spot checks. Application Step by step, with requirements per certification and BankID signing. Exam Exam sessions are booked through a connected exam service. Review Evidence is reviewed against control points and non-conformities are recorded. Decision Approve, reject or send back for review. Certificate Decision letter, certificate and ID card where needed. Follow-up Competence reports, spot checks, reminders, suspension and revocation. Certifications in production Requirements are set per certification, so each role gets the right application and the right assessment. pages.title: RoutePlanner: route planning for audits | Veridens
pages.text: RoutePlanner: route planning for audits | Veridens Skip to content Solutions Products Contact Svenska Book a demo New A whole year of audits, planned in minutes RoutePlanner splits the audits into trips and days, most urgent first and inside every certification window. The planning itself takes seconds. Book a demo Route planning, from planning export to driving route, in two minutes Import, period planning, AI review and the trip day by day. Sample data, music only. Measured on a full year audits 1,286 auditors 23 trips 274 to plan them all 3.5 s Every audit landed inside its certification window. Measured on 2 October 2026 with an anonymised planning export for 2027. From planning export to finished schedule Six steps, and the planner has the final say in each. Import Load your planning export. The facilities appear on the map. Scope Choose auditor, region, type of visit and period. Shape trips Number of days, hours per day, how full trips should be and how far they may reach. Plan The audits are split into trips, most urgent first. Fine-tune Move stops, hand one over to a colleague or optimise the whole trip. Review An AI review suggests changes. You choose which to apply. Built for auditors who drive Certification windows Every visit is planned inside the window in which the audit must happen. Days with overnight stops The trip is split into days by driving and visit time. Every day except the last ends at an overnight stop. Hotels and food Hotels and restaurants near the overnight stop are shown on the map. Home as the base Trips start and end at the auditor's home. Handover A stop that suits a colleague better is handed over in one click. Times per stop Every stop gets an arrival time, driving time and visit time. AI that suggests, never decides The review reads your planning rules and each trip's distances, towns and windows. It answers with a verdict, findings and concrete changes, such as merging two island weeks or handing a stop over. The planner chooses what is applied. See your audits on the map We show RoutePlanner with an example that resembles your planning. Book a demo Or call +46 455-341030 The platform for Nordic certification bodies. pages.title: SERMI for certification bodies | Veridens
pages.text: SERMI for certification bodies | Veridens Skip to content Solutions Products Contact Svenska Book a demo Solutions SERMI, from application to certificate For CABs approving independent operators and their employees under SERMI. In production with Kiwa in Sweden and Norway. Book a demo SERMI approval under your brand, in under 90 seconds Application, review, certificate and inspection under your own brand. Sample data, music only. Sound familiar? Both the operator and every employee must be assessed and certified. The operator applies and adds its employees. An authorised representative signs the application with BankID, and employee certificates are issued through a connected trust service. Spot checks have to be planned and followed up. Spot checks and extra reviews are created automatically and passed on to planning. Expired certificates stay active. Expired certificates are revoked automatically. Operators and employees get reminders well ahead. Non-conformity deadlines are hard to keep track of. Cases have deadlines and the operator is reminded about open non-conformities. How a SERMI case runs Separate roles for operator, employee, CAB and inspector. Application The operator registers and signs with BankID. Review The CAB reviews against control points and records non-conformities. Inspection Premises are inspected with a checklist and the inspector's signature. Decision The CAB decides on approval. Certificate Employee certificates are issued. Reports and certificates as PDF. Follow-up Spot checks, reminders and revocation when certificates expire. Roles and connections Swedish and Norwegian BankID are supported.
